issue: ‘सुख दुःख की दाता’: literally ‘giver of joy and sorrow’; in praise it may mean the giver of joy who takes away sorrow.
our reading: she is the giver of joy and sorrow
alternatives: giver of joy in place of sorrow; she who dispenses joy and sorrow as each deserves

our reading: without you, the Vaitaraṇī lies before me
alternatives: without you, (who will take me across) the Vaitaraṇī?
